messages:
alex: Heads-up: after we shifted 25% of production traffic to edge-fallback the dashboard p95 for /v1/generate jumped from ~300ms -> ~1.6s. p50 stayed ~100ms. p99 occasionally shows ~3s. Anyone who knows the fallback cluster internals?

maya: Did the change also alter request partitioning (tokens per request) or client-tiering? those can silently push requests to slower queues.

chen: I instrumented the fallback pool. two signals: (1) batch latency distribution changed (more single-request batches), (2) there's an extra ingress proxy in that region that adds ~80-220ms intermittently. small sample from logs: 
```
SELECT approx_percentile(lat_ms, 95) p95, approx_percentile(lat_ms, 99) p99, count(*) cnt
FROM request_log
WHERE variant='edge-fallback' AND route='/v1/generate' AND ts > now() - interval '20 minute'
```
result: p95=1600, p99=2800, cnt=95

taylor: Console note: our p95 is built from 10s sampled rollups (server-side summarization). with cnt<100 the p95 becomes very noisy. we should surface sample counts and sample origin (rollup tier) next to the percentile. users assume it's raw raw.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: route-weight update at 1718893800 1% -> edge-fallback.

indra: Also check kvcache & batching headers. If cache hit drops, model compute increases and tails widen. see header `x-rw-kvcache=miss/ hit`.

chen: verified: kvcache hit rate for edge-fallback dropped from 86% -> 67% in the last 30m. batch size median 1 -> 2. distribution attached in logs (links omitted).

maya: So likely contributors: reduced batching efficiency + kvcache misses + ingress proxy jitter. Routing policy didn't consider p95 when deciding weights. It used p50 and utilization only.

alex: From ops perspective we need short and midterm actions: immediate (1) console should show sample count + annotation of routing change; (2) mark that p95 is from sampled rollups when count < 500; (3) infra to check proxy retries and upstream timeout settings. midterm: telemetry to emit per-variant kvcache hit-rate rollups and batch-size histograms, and routing policy to add a p95 penalty term.

taylor: UX: I'll add a small badge on the latency chart that says "samples: N (rollup)" and a hover tooltip explaining origin. Should take a few hrs.

indra: I'll add a telemetry event emitting `telemetry.variant.kvcache_hit_rate` and `telemetry.variant.batch_size_p50_p95` every minute for each variant.

chen: I'll extract slow-trace waterfall for top 30 requests and grep for auth-proxy retries. will share traces in #incidents. due EOD.

maya: For routing policy discussion: I propose a soft penalty P = max(0, (p95 - baseline_p95) / baseline_p95) * lambda where lambda is small. we'd simulate to pick lambda. also consider a hysteresis window so short spikes don't flip weights.

alex: Good proposal. assign to product + infra to simulate. summary of owners: taylor (console), indra (telemetry), chen (traces), maya+alex (routing sims). tagging follow-up meeting tomorrow 10:00. :thumbsup:
